area_has_owner.suggestion: Name an owner for the area so its readiness can be attested

required_documents_defined.fail: Gate {gate} has applicable areas without any required frame document
required_documents_defined.suggestion: Attach the frame documents the catalogue requires for this gate, or mark the area not applicable with a reason

binding_document_unchanged.fail: Binding frame document {document} has a newer revision that is not covered by an approved change request
binding_document_unchanged.suggestion: Raise a change request so the new revision is approved before it is used

conditions_not_overdue.suggestion: Clear the condition with evidence, or have the decider waive it with a reason

gate_date_after_previous.fail: Gate {gate} is planned on {date}, before the previous gate on {previous}
gate_date_after_previous.suggestion: Move the gate date so gates follow the phase order

decision_by_entitled_user.fail: The decision on gate {gate} was recorded by a user who owns one of its areas
decision_by_entitled_user.suggestion: Under the four-eyes rule a different person must decide

not_applicable_has_rationale.fail: Area {area} is marked not applicable without a reason
not_applicable_has_rationale.suggestion: Write down why the area does not apply
